title: 🏗️ Crane Installation — BTS MS
hero_tagline: Théo supervises the crane lift · Reading & Grammar
foot: 🏗️ BTS MS · Heavy Lift & Installation — B1–B2 · self-marking 🏗️
story: Théo works as a maintenance technician in a large factory. Every week, he plans the servicing of the machines and supervises the team. Today is special: a new hydraulic press arrives, and he must oversee its installation.

This morning, two trucks delivered the press in several parts. A mobile crane lifted the heaviest part — nearly twelve tonnes — over the wall and lowered it slowly onto the concrete base. The riggers attached the load with steel slings and guided it into position.

Since then, the team has bolted the machine to the floor and has checked the alignment twice. They haven't started the commissioning yet, but everything is on schedule. Théo has already signed the safety checklist.
During the lift, Théo talked with the foreman and the crane operator:

Foreman: "The load is very heavy — over ten tonnes."
Théo: "We must check the slings before we lift."
Operator: "I can lift it now."
Théo: "Wait — the area isn't clear yet."
Foreman: "OK, the machine is in position."
Théo: "Good. We have finished the alignment."
By the end of the day, the press was ready for testing. 🏗️

sections.name: TN Tenses
sections.heading: Present simple, past simple or present perfect?
sections.instr: Le repère de temps t'indique le temps à choisir.

items.text: Théo usually ___ the maintenance team.
A good foreman always ___ a lifting plan first.
Yesterday, the crane ___ the new press into the workshop.
Last week, the supplier ___ the equipment on two trucks.
Since this morning, the team ___ the machine to the floor.
The engineers ___ the alignment for two hours now.
The technician has just ___ the safety test.
___ the machine start correctly last night?

sections.name: TR Traduction
sections.heading: Traduis : quel temps ?
sections.instr: Lis la phrase française et choisis la bonne traduction anglaise. Le repère de temps te dit quel temps utiliser.

items.text: « Le technicien graisse les roulements chaque semaine. » ___
options: The technician greased the bearings every week.
The technician greases the bearings every week.
items.answer: The technician greases the bearings every week.

items.text: « Hier, la grue est tombée en panne. » ___
options: Yesterday, the crane has broken down.

items.text: « Depuis lundi, nous avons remplacé trois moteurs. » ___
options: Since Monday, we have replaced three motors.
Since Monday, we replaced three motors.
items.answer: Since Monday, we have replaced three motors.

items.text: « L'usine fonctionne 24 heures sur 24. » ___
options: The factory ran 24 hours a day.
The factory runs 24 hours a day.
items.answer: The factory runs 24 hours a day.

items.text: « Il y a un mois, ils ont modernisé la ligne de production. » ___
options: A month ago, they modernized the production line.
A month ago, they have modernized the production line.
items.answer: A month ago, they modernized the production line.

items.text: « Le fournisseur nous livre des pièces depuis 2018. » ___
options: The supplier has delivered parts to us since 2018.
The supplier delivered parts to us since 2018.
items.answer: The supplier has delivered parts to us since 2018.

items.text: « L'année dernière, le pont roulant a soulevé un moteur de 8 tonnes. » ___
options: Last year, the overhead crane lifted an 8-tonne motor.
Last year, the overhead crane has lifted an 8-tonne motor.
items.answer: Last year, the overhead crane lifted an 8-tonne motor.

items.text: « Nous n'avons pas encore réglé la pression. » ___
options: We haven't set the pressure yet.
We didn't set the pressure yet.
items.answer: We haven't set the pressure yet.

sections.name: FT For/To
sections.heading: FOR or TO?
sections.instr: « pour » se traduit par TO + verbe (le but) ou par FOR + nom. Choisis le bon mot.

items.text: They used a crane ___ lift the press.
This sling is ___ heavy loads only.
He wore gloves ___ protect his hands.
Thank you ___ your help with the installation.
Théo checked the bolts ___ make sure they were tight.
This wrench is ___ tightening the anchor bolts.
They stopped the line ___ install the new machine.
The team met ___ a safety briefing.

sections.name: RS Reported
sections.heading: Reported speech (said / told)
sections.instr: On rapporte le dialogue du chantier. say / tell (+ personne) ; le temps recule (is → was, can → could, must → had to, have → had).

items.text: "The load is very heavy," said the foreman. → The foreman said the load ___ very heavy.
Théo ___ the operator to wait.
"I can lift it now." → The operator said he ___ lift it.
"We must check the slings." → Théo said they ___ check the slings.
"The area isn't clear." → Théo said the area ___ clear.
"We have finished the alignment." → Théo said they ___ finished the alignment.
Théo ___ that the machine was in position.
Théo told the operator ___ start the crane.
